title: Scam and Fraud
body: I opted for a 7-Day FREE trial but was immediately charged. After a couple of hours I realized that this app was not what I was looking for, and unsubscribed but got no refund in return! I even emailed the developer and got an automated email saying that if I wanted a refund I should complain with Apple. Why not do things right in the first place? Do you even know what FREE means? Fraudulent marketing.
